The '''1951–52 Scottish Division A''' was won by [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]] by four points over nearest rival [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[Greenock Morton F.C.|Greenock Morton]] and [[Stirling Albion F.C.|Stirling Albion]] finished 15th and 16th respectively and were relegated to the [[1952–53 Scottish Division B]].

This was the first time in the history of the Scottish top tier that a team other than [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] or Rangers managed to successfully defend their league trophy and won two leagues in a row, a feature only repeated since by [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]] in [[1983–84 Scottish Premier Division|1984]] and [[1984–85 Scottish Premier Division|1985]]. It was also the fourth and, as of 2025, last time that Hibernian won the league.
